observed_defect: A live worker PID is accepted as reusable without proving a fresh task-capable runtime tick. A stalled WorkerCoordinator can therefore remain PID-alive while requests stop progressing and the existing self-heal path declines to repair it.
proposed_repair: For an existing live worker PID, require a bounded fresh tick. If it advances, reuse it. If it remains alive but does not advance, terminate the stale process, wait for exit, and restart the existing canonical worker runner; accept repair only after a fresh tick.

readme_impact.reason: This changes resident failure-recovery semantics: self-heal will recover a stalled PID-alive WorkerCoordinator rather than only a missing/dead process. README must document the expanded failure behavior in the same change set.
